notes.title: Blue Protocol: Star Resonance Launches on October 9, 2025
notes.notes: [p]Tokyo, Japan (September 16, 2025) – The highly anticipated anime-inspired MMORPG [b]Blue Protocol: Star Resonance[/b] will [b]officially launch[/b] across [b]Europe[/b], [b]North America[/b], and [b]South America[/b] on [b]October 9, 2025[/b]. The game invites players to dive into a fun fantasy story, embark on an adventure with friends, and enjoy every moment in this anime-style world of Regnus. Fans can now wishlist the game on Steam and the Epic Games Store, and pre-register on Google Play and App Store to prepare for the adventure. The game will support [b]cross-platform play[/b] between [b]mobile[/b] and [b]PC[/b], allowing players to enjoy a seamless experience across devices with synchronized progression.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621712/34e9bed763881b59625804e87fda0bade1e270c4.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]A Heartfelt Thank-You to Our Beta Testers[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The recent closed beta test was met with an incredible response, drawing over [b]29,000[/b] players into the world of Regnus. The development team extends its deepest gratitude to all participants. Their valuable feedback is being actively used to polish and improve the game for the official launch. To celebrate the community's spirit, a special commemorative video has been created, featuring players' best moments from the beta, featuring the game's official English theme song, "[b]Starlight Over Asterleeds~星々が輝く場所~[/b]". [/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="z6bKivohbM4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2][b]Unlock Exclusive Crunchyroll Member Benefits[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Adventuring in [b]Blue Protocol: Star Resonance[/b] with a Crunchyroll Membership is better! Upon launch, players with any Crunchyroll Membership tier—new and existing—can log in with their credentials to receive exclusive in-game rewards, including avatar frames, mount skins, and more to customize their adventure. Stay-tuned for more details on [b]official channels[/b].[/p][p][/p][h2][b]What is Blue Protocol: Star Resonance?[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]For those new to the world of Regnus, Blue Protocol: Star Resonance offers a rich MMORPG experience defined by several [b]key highlights[/b]:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Anime-Styled Visuals[/b]: Stunning graphics create an immersive anime-style world while preserving the high-quality visuals of Project Skyblue.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Dynamic Combat System[/b]: Class system, talent build, skill sets, and equipment enable personalized combat style customization, with iterative content updates actively diversifying the approaches.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Open World[/b]: Explore expansive landscapes filled with quests, dungeons, and epic raids.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Deep Character Customization[/b]: Expand character customization, enabling players to craft their own distinct personalities.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Multi-player Social Experience[/b]: Trade, guilds, and community events enhance the multiplayer experience.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Follow Blue Protocol: Star Resonance:[/b] [/h3][p]Website: [url="https://www.playbpsr.com"]https://www.playbpsr.com[/url]  [/p][p]Twitter/X: [url="https://x.com/BPSR_Official"]https://x.com/BPSR_Official[/url]  [/p][p]YouTube: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@BPSR_Official"][/dynamiclink]  [/p][p]Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/starresonance"]https://discord.gg/starresonance[/url]  [/p][p]Tiktok: [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@bpsr_official"]https://www.tiktok.com/@bpsr_official[/url]  [/p][p]Kwai: [url="https://k.kwai.com/u/@BPSR_Official/try0xzCJ"]https://k.kwai.com/u/@BPSR_Official/try0xzCJ[/url][/p]

notes.title: Bandai's canceled anime MMO Blue Protocol gets launch date; it's officially back
notes.notes:
Blue Protocol: Star Resonance has quite the history. Bandai Namco Online shuttered the Japanese version of the anime MMO in early 2025, with Amazon Games' western port biting the dust in August of 2024. It seemed like it was dead and buried, but nine months ago a report confirmed that Shanghai Bokura Network Technology was resurrecting the troubled title, creating a spinoff set in Regnus with similar elements to the original game. Since then there's been a beta test, and now the developer has given it an official launch date - and it's pretty soon.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Resurrected anime MMORPG Blue Protocol is back with a new beta
notes.notes:
For me, half the fun of a good MMORPG is the ability to move between adventuring and relaxing. I love to fish just as much as I love to bash monsters, and, thankfully, Blue Protocol: Star Resonance looks set to tick all of those boxes, sending it straight to the top of my wishlist. With no confirmed release date, I thought I might be waiting a while to dive into Regnas, but luck appears to be on our side, as recruitment for a new closed beta has just kicked off.

notes.title: Canceled Amazon MMO Blue Protocol has been resurrected, and it's coming soon
notes.notes:
May 16, 2025: Correction - The decision to end service on the original Blue Protocol was Bandai Namco Online's, not Amazon Games'.

Despite my love for colorful, fantasy anime aesthetics, I've never quite gotten on with the likes of Genshin Impact. Perhaps it's the gacha, or having to keep up with what feels like volumes worth of bizarre terminology - I've just never been able to commit to any of HoYoverse's long-running games. That's why Blue Protocol was so exciting to me - to quote Amazon at the time, the MMO was supposed to be about undertaking a "fantastical journey," where the story was at the core of the gameplay. But, that simply wasn't to be; back in August 2024, Bandai Namco Online decided to end service for Blue Protocol, which halted its planned Western launch in collab with Amazon Games.

notes.title: Blue Protocol Star Resonance release date estimate, trailers, and latest news
notes.notes:
What is the Blue Protocol Star Resonance release date? Much like a phoenix rising from the ashes, Blue Protocol Star Resonance is emerging from the tattered husk that was, ahem, Blue Protocol. A reimagining, a kind of spin-off, a new lease of life - whatever it is, it's good news for those who love their MMOs with an anime twist.

How much has changed since the rebrand from Blue Protocol to Blue Protocol Star Resonance is currently unclear, but going from what we have seen, the MMO looks to be a fun romp through beautiful locales, fishing trips with friends, and fearsome boss fights.
